newsitem.title: FINLAND: STROMSDAL SEES HIGHER '97 EARNINGS, SALES.
newsitem.headline: STROMSDAL SEES HIGHER '97 EARNINGS, SALES.

text.p: Finnish paperboard maker Stromsdal Oy said on Friday it expected earnings to improve and net sales to rise this year compared to 1996.
"I expect earnings to improve compared to 1996," Stromsdal managing director Bjorn Forss told Reuters in an interview at company headquarters in Juankoski, central Finland.

Forss said Stromsdal hoped that sales of a new product it launched last spring, a recycable coating material for food packaging paper and paper board, would increase annual turnover by up to 100 million markka.
In 1996, sales of this product accounted for just 1.5 percent of Stromsdal's total net sales at 233 million markka.
Forss said the market situation early this year had been "slightly weaker than normal."
"If pulp prices rise moderately it will increase demand for graphic paper board," he added. --Veera Heinonen, +358-9-680 50 240, e-mail news@reuters.fi
